rca.exact_trigger: unknown_independently_unverifiable because the historical runner raised before persisting the violating request window
rca.supporting_observation: The three preceding accepted 800-RPS logistic steps retained only 534600 to 778600 ns between the final enqueue and the frozen window end; this does not identify the missing GaussianNB violation but demonstrates narrow scheduler margin.
